title: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) identifies upregulated carbohydrate metabolism pathways in tumors with high tumor-specific total mRNA expression (TmS)
body:
##  Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) identifies upregulated carbohydrate metabolism pathways in tumors with high tumor-specific total mRNA expression (TmS) 

Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) conducted on Reactome’s carbohydrate metabolism pathways identifies the [Pentose phosphate pathway](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-71336>) and the [Glucose metabolism ](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-70326>)pathway as the two most frequently upregulated pathways in tumors with high tumor-specific total mRNA expression (TmS) across 15 tumor types; TmS is a novel tumor phenotype-predictive quantitative feature described by [Cao et al. in the November 2022 issue of Nature Biotechnology](<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-022-01342-x>).
